run_main_training: run the main function to train a DPR model using Hydra config and PyTorch Lightning
run_main_test_only: run the main function in test-only mode using a pretrained checkpoint path
instantiate_task_with_hydra: instantiate a task object from the Hydra config using hydra.utils.instantiate with recursive disabled
instantiate_datamodule_with_transform: instantiate a datamodule from the Hydra config passing in a transform object
create_trainer_with_callbacks: create a PyTorch Lightning Trainer with checkpoint and learning rate monitor callbacks
